neighbours.label: Qur'an citation context: the tokens of a surah's name after 'Surah/Surat' (Maryam, al-Kahf) and the divine 'We' inside a quoted verse; quiet on Bible citations, hadith and general Islam talk
fire: The command to be kind to parents appears in the Quran (Surah al-Isra, 23-24).
Scholars often quote the opening lines of Surah Yusuf when teaching the story.
The rules of inheritance are laid out in Surah an-Nisa, verses 11 and 12.
The imam recited a passage about the bees (Surat an-Nahl, 68-69).
Many Muslims read Surah Yasin on Friday mornings.
The story of Moses and the wise servant is told in Surah Taha and elsewhere.
The Quran says of the believers: And We shall test you with fear and hunger.
As the verse in the Quran puts it: Indeed, We created man from clay.
quiet: The command to honour parents appears in the Bible (Exodus 20, 12).
Scholars often quote the opening lines of the Book of Genesis when teaching the story.
The rules of inheritance are laid out in the Book of Numbers, chapter 27.
The priest recited a passage about the lilies (Luke 12, 27-28).
Many Muslims visit the mosque on Friday mornings.
The story of Moses and the burning bush is told in the Torah and elsewhere.
The preacher said of the believers: they shall be tested with fear and hunger.
As the old saying puts it: indeed, we are all made of clay.

notes: Card top examples are surah names in citations (English and Arabic) and ' We' in quoted verses. Probes: Surah Maryam 0.90, Surah al-Kahf 0.99, quoted 'We' 0.72; Gospel of Matthew 0.00, hadith 0.01, Ramadan 0.03.
